prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent website hero illustration for Coffee & Fun, an independent software development company. Create ONE original cheerful red ceramic coffee-cup character, with warm white interior, dark coffee, a simple small golden coffee-bean emblem on its body, bright friendly eyes and a confident mischievous smile. It has short flexible dark charcoal cartoon arms with cream gloves, and chunky cream sneakers. The character is sitting casually beside a small open teal laptop with a simple yellow asterisk sticker; one hand rests on the laptop and the other waves. Three playful curls of steam rise from the cup. Style: highly polished bold flat commercial illustration, thick clean charcoal outlines, rounded expressive shapes, limited solid colors, playful contemporary coffee-brand art. Composition: square, full character and laptop visible, centered, large subject, room around all extremities, a few small coral and golden spark marks. Colors: tomato red #f45139, golden yellow #ffc83d, teal #30bda5, cream #fff8e7, charcoal #242329. Transparent background, no colored rectangle, no text, no words, no logotype, no watermark, no gradients, no drop shadow rectangle. Must be an original character, not a sun mascot or any existing brand mascot.
